integrity: Every claimed formula is derived from finite-filter and coordinate normal forms; previously known definitions, filter/quantifier correspondence and Bell counts are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Classification only for the punctured Boolean distributive nearlattice with the stated quasi-modal axioms; an equivalent historical formulation might exist. Finite verifier is corroborating, not a proof of the general case.
title: Principal-filter spectrum and monadic rigidity on punctured Boolean nearlattices
